audience: rental businesses that take orders and track items in Ellibo

useCases.title: Check the rental stock
useCases.text: List the rental items with the number of units owned. Open one for its details.

useCases.title: Find late rental orders
useCases.text: List the rental orders with their lines. Check which orders are late and when they are due back.

useCases.title: Review the invoices of an order
useCases.text: Read one rental order with its status. Then list the invoices of that order.

useCases.title: Find the pickup and return places
useCases.text: List the pickup and return places, to tell customers where to collect or return items.
